import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] aLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(aLine[i]) % m;
        }

        Set<Integer> leftPart = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> rightPart = new HashSet<>();

        enumerateSubsets(a, leftPart, 0, n / 2, 0, m);
        enumerateSubsets(a, rightPart, n / 2, n, 0, m);

        List<Integer> rightSorted = new ArrayList<>(rightPart);
        Collections.sort(rightSorted);

        int maxTotal = 0;
        for (int val : leftPart) {
            int pos = Collections.binarySearch(rightSorted, m - val);
            if (pos < 0) {
                pos = -pos - 1;
            }
            if (pos > 0) {
                int totalCandidate = val + rightSorted.get(pos - 1);
                if (totalCandidate > maxTotal) {
                    maxTotal = totalCandidate;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxTotal);
    }

    private static void enumerateSubsets(int[] a, Set<Integer> sumsSet, int start, int end, int currentSum, int m) {
        if (start == end) {
            sumsSet.add(currentSum);
        } else {
            enumerateSubsets(a, sumsSet, start + 1, end, (currentSum + a[start]) % m, m);
            enumerateSubsets(a, sumsSet, start + 1, end, currentSum, m);
        }
    }
}
